## evomem
{
  "memory": {
    "description": "[YOU] Core content of this memory atom. Stores raw conversation, distilled facts, or internal reasoning depending on type.",
    "type": "string"
  },
  "metadata": {
    "id": {
      "description": "[SYSTEM] Unique identifier. Auto-generated by system.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type": {
      "description": "[SYSTEM for raw] raw: unprocessed input, auto-set by system. [YOU for inner/outer] inner: always loaded into agent context. outer: loaded into context only when needed.",
      "type": "enum",
      "values": ["inner", "outer", "raw"]
    },
    "time": {
      "description": "[YOU] Temporal scope. Always include temporal information if present in the fact; do NOT drop dates, durations, or relative times. Prefer absolute time when resolvable from context (e.g. 'in 2018' not 'five years ago' if the session year is known). Use ISO 8601. For ranges, use 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD'.If can not solve, use original descrptio like 'two day before Alan was born'. If completely unknown or no need to use time to describe, use empty string ''. Only to the exact unit of time that can be confirmed.",
      "type": "string",
      "examples": [
        "2026-09-14",
        "2026-09-14T10:30:00Z",
        "2026-09-01/2026-09-15",
        "two day before Alan was born",
        ""
      ]
    },
    "tag": {
      "description": "[YOU] Array of key-value labels. MUST include at least one 'speaker:<name>'. Other tags from Tag Taxonomy: topic, entity, sentiment, action, state, relation, other. Format: 'key:value'.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[a-z]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]+$"
      }
    },
    "source": {
      "description": "[YOU] IDs of source memories for provenance tracing. Empty for raw type.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "changelog": {
      "description": "[SYSTEM time + YOU content] Version history. Time auto-generated on modification. Content records previous memory value.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "time": { "description": "[SYSTEM] When change occurred.", "type": "string" },
          "content": { "description": "[YOU] Previous content before change.", "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
目标：逐步优化细化演化atommem
**当前实现（QA 驱动）**：针对每对 speakers，对**每条 QA 问题**：
1. 用问题的文本在 atommem 上做**混合检索**（`src/codemem/searchmem.py`：dense + BM25 + tag
   三路通道，用 RRF 倒数排名融合，`score(d)=Σ_r w_r/(k+rank_r(d))`，k=60、权重
   dense=1.0 / bm25=1.0 / tag=0.5），得到 top_k 个**候选原子**；
2. 对候选集内的每条原子（按 atom_key 顺序）跑内层 agent loop 演化 —— 演化的证据仍是
   "从此原子之前（严格 key <）的存活原子里召回 top_k 条 + 附上 source 的 msgmem 与
   前后 context_window 条上下文"；
3. 得到该问题的"更优的、更可能回答它的"原子集合，并落一条 QA trajectory。

**为什么按 QA 驱动而不是逐条走库**：旧版对库里每条原子都跑一遍内层循环，成本
`原子数 × 轮数`（最坏上千条原子 × 4 轮），且大部分精修与任何问题都无关；新版只演化
"问题相关"的候选集，成本 `QA 数 × 候选数 × 轮数`，并且演化目标明确（让候选集能回答该问题），
一条 QA 一条 trajectory 也便于后续 RL。
每条 QA 都从同一份 base 库出发（QA 之间互不影响），base `atommem.jsonl` 始终不被修改。

**prompt**：`EVOMEM_PROMPT` 的 `{{QUESTION}}` 槽把问题告诉模型（"为什么这条原子此刻被演化"），
其余占位符 `{{CURRENT}}`（单条目标）/ `{{RECALLED}}`（证据）/ `{{HISTORY}}` / `{{SCHEMA}}` 不变。


动作空间：ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, NOOP
ADD: 添加新的atommem, 需要大模型生成的内容有memory，type[inner outer], time, tag, source(msgmem_id or atommem_id list), id和changelog有系统处理。可能一次性添加多个新的记忆，所以输出是atommem列表，需要包含所有的字段，id和changelog留空
UPDATE: 更新记忆，输出current_atommem和召回的atommem的更新之后的列表，
DELETE: 删除，输出要删除的atommem列表，输出原始的要删除的atommem列表，这样更严谨，不使用id来删除是因为删除id可能误删，这就跟真实人类比如github要删除一个仓库，需要输入完整名称才能删除。
NOOP: 什么都不做
为保证输出格式统一，ADD，UPDATE，DELETE都输出atommem列表，这样更好训练，也更好解析，prompt也能够更简约有效
输出结构为<ADD>[atommem_list]</ADD>，<UPDATE>[atommem_list]</UPDATE>，<DELETE>[atommem_list]</DELETE>，<NOOP></NOOP>

测试时使用configs\evomem.yaml这个里面的配置，目前还不需要强化学习训练，先看直接通过prompt演化效果如何
